question.text: The equation of the plane containing the line \(\frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x}_1}{\ell}=\frac{\mathrm{y}-\mathrm{y}_1}{\mathrm{~m}}=\frac{\mathrm{z}-\mathrm{z}_1}{\mathrm{n}}\) is \(a\left(x-x_1\right)+b\left(y-y_1\right)+c\left(z-z_1\right)=0\), then

solution.text: If the given plane contains the given line then the normal to the plane, must be perpendicular to the line and the condition for the same is \(a \ell+b m+c n=0\).
